responsibility: Declares the full-HIR visitor used for Rust const checking. It defines the ConstChecker entry point, the internal const-context classification for different generic owners, and the helper APIs for const function calls and default const-generic validation, along with the extensive visit hooks needed to traverse HIR expressions, items, statements, and types while enforcing const-context rules.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration half of the const-checker pair: unlike rust-const-checker.cc, it defines the ConstChecker class, helper APIs, internal context enum, and the large set of visitor overrides without the checking logic itself.
